title: The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes
abstract: arXiv:2610.12809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. translated_title: 随机特征MPNN在不同图规模上的表达能力
translated_abstract: 连续随机节点特征可以提升消息传递神经网络的表达能力，但现有的理论分析还不够精细，无法刻画其局限性，尤其是在跨图规模逼近函数或在固定数量随机比特条件下的情形。我们建立了一个用于规模一致逼近的总体层面分析框架。对于初始特征具有与图规模无关的Lipschitz界的MPNN（包括标准的均值、最大值以及阶归一化和等架构），我们证明连续随机特征可以被量化为有限多种颜色，同时使期望输出上的均匀误差任意小。这一约简使我们能够将有限颜色可区分性上的限制转化为连续随机特征下规模一致逼近的限制。我们利用该框架证明了这类MPNN不具备规模一致的通用性，并分析了颜色和独立随机特征所带来的表达能力提升。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个总体层面的规模一致逼近分析框架，通过将连续随机特征量化为有限种颜色，证明了具有图规模无关Lipschitz界的MPNN不具备跨图规模的通用逼近能力。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation, showing via quantization of continuous random features into finitely many colors that MPNNs with graph-size-independent Lipschitz bounds are provably not size-uniformly universal.
